data.name: Shreejesh
data.gender_notes: Shreejesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shree means prosperity and Jesh means god. Thus, Shreejesh means God of Prosperity. The name Shreejesh carries the meaning “God of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shreejesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the abundance and prosperity bestowed by the divine.
data.etymology: Shreejesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shreejesh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shreejesh holds significant cultural importance in the Hindu tradition. In Hindu mythology, there are several deities associated with prosperity, wealth, and abundance. One of the most popular among them is Lord Ganesha, who is also known as Shri Ganesh. 'Shree' in the name Shreejesh is a correspondence to the devotional term 'Shri,' which means 'god' in Sanskrit. So, Shreejesh can be considered as a Devotional Name for the Hindu God of Prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shreejesh holds profound spiritual significance for Hindus. In Hinduism, it is believed that the divine energy or vibration, known as 'Shakti,' exists within everything, including the names we give to our deities and ourselves. The name Shreejesh signifies the presence of God and prosperity within an individual. Chanting or hearing the name Shreejesh is believed to bring peace, happiness, and prosperity. It reminds us of the divine blessings and the abundance that the universe has to offer us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shreejesh: God of wealth and prosperity, embodiment of auspiciousness and abundance in one's life. The name is a combination of Shree (Goddess of wealth and prosperity) and Ish (God, the supreme consciousness).

historical_references.reference: Shreejesh is believed to be an incarnation of Lord Vishnu, particularly popular in Maharashtra, India. He is also known as Keshav or Keshavji.
historical_references.context: During the Bhakti movement in Maharashtra, Shreejesh became popular as a deity among the Maratha people, and temples were built in his honor.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Shreejesh is found in the Puranas, where he is described as the son of King Mandhata and Princess Shrutakirti. According to legend, Shreejesh helped his father defeat a demon named Sahasrarjaya.
historical_references.context: The Puranas are a collection of religious texts in Hinduism, and they contain various stories and legends about gods and heroes.
